title: Polynomial-time computation of an exponential width
statement: There exist a finite deterministic Turing machine $M$ over the binary alphabet and a natural number $A$ such that, for every binary input $x$, $M$ outputs the binary expansion of $C\cdot 2^{(|x|+1)^c}$ within $A(|x|+1)^{c+1}$ steps, for the given natural numbers $C,c$.
hypotheses_covered: the stated output and time bound hold for every binary input
replaced: For all natural numbers $C$ and $c$ there exist a deterministic machine and a constant $A$ computing, on every input $x$, the little-endian binary expansion of $C \cdot 2^{(|x|+1)^c}$ within $A\,(|x|+1)^{c+1}$ steps.
